comparison.objective: Declutch a powered valve actuator and manually close it; candidate adjusts and locks a gripper opening stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Holding a lever while turning a handwheel until clutch engagement differs from seating separate coaxial tools and counterholding an adjusted screw during jam-nut tightening.
comparison.success_condition: Clutch engaged and valve closed versus precise stop angle locked without drift and verified through three released cycles.
comparison.reason: This is a plausible primitive-level neighbor, but its mode-change-and-turn ability is meaningfully different; no indexed task.json/spec exists, and the PR body omits full setup dimensions without creating ambiguity about that distinction.
